⚡ Pre-Ingest Control Surface

Start with the runtime failure that formed before monitoring saw it.

The Failure Nobody Saw is the canonical public validation lab for Fieldglass: a SWE-Bench-like repair workflow where benchmark results appear successful, latency remains normal, errors stay quiet, and tool availability appears healthy, yet failure formation has already begun.

Fieldglass reveals the hidden lead-time window between benchmark success and production failure. It surfaces drift acceleration, role fragmentation, and instability pressure before visible breakdown occurs, allowing operators to observe failure formation while intervention remains possible.

Runtime Signals

Core structural signals measured across Fieldglass. These indicators track trajectory stability, continuity, pressure accumulation, coherence, structural noise, and runtime risk.

Runtime Invariants
(a) Trajectory Stabilityκ(t)
Low movement away from stable trajectory. Stable runs remain inside coherent behavioral boundaries.
(b) Continuity SignalEcho Sᵢⱼ
Tracks recurring patterns across turns. Strong continuity indicates stable reasoning and memory flow.
(c) Instability Pressureλₜ
Rising pressure can indicate divergence before visible failure. Spikes may signal pre-collapse conditions.
(d) Coherence / Structural NoiseΠ(t) / H(t)
Measures consolidation versus fragmentation of runtime structure. Lower noise → stronger coherence.

4 · ⌁ Ingestion Limits & Evidence Preservation

limits + evidence preservation
Fieldglass prioritizes evidence completeness over visualization.
Small Run0–250 turnsFull telemetry • Full visualization • Full export
Long Run251–1,000 turnsFull telemetry • Sampled visualization • Chunked export
Very Long Run1,001–2,500 turnsBatch mode • Summary-first • Limited live visuals

Recommended Limits

  • Public: 250 turns / ~250k characters
  • Extended Local: 1,000 turns / ~1M characters
  • Experimental: 2,500 turns / ~2.5M characters

Preservation Policy

Fieldglass computes all available evidence first and reduces visualization complexity only when necessary.

Evidence is preserved. Visualization adapts.

◈ Metric Cards

Focused inspection
ⓘ Instrument metric semantics

Metric cards use progressive disclosure: operational meaning is public, canonical abbreviations remain visible, and implementation mechanics remain abstracted. This preserves scientific legibility without exposing calibration weights or proprietary transforms.

Coherence (CI): operational continuity of the runtime trajectory. Recurrence (RD): degree of repeated structural behavior. Fragmentation (ELF): evidence of local breakdown or fragmentation pressure. Structural Drift (CSI): trajectory shear / drift pressure.

Identity Continuity (ICI): persistence of anchor-like runtime identity signals. Basin Integrity: proximity to basin-exit pressure. Temporal Volatility (TV): short-horizon instability fluctuation. Temporal Stability (TSR): directional continuity over time.

Evidence State · Evidentiary validityQuestion: Is this run evidentially valid? Shows telemetry-bearing turns, detected transitions, lead-time confidence, role coverage, export readiness, missing evidence warnings, and claim boundaries.

How Chronos becomes evidenceThese readings are not decorative metrics. They become exportable evidence properties used by the Evidence Artifact, Human Read Layer, and decision-maker summary.
1 · Kernel telemetryTV, TCC, ETG, TSR, and STC measure symbolic-time deformation directly from the computed run.
2 · Intelligence layerTBI, TAS, TAI, TRS, TFS, TPS, and TPO translate temporal motion into branch, anomaly, resilience, and recovery evidence.
3 · Role-aware supportRole phase lag, tool-loop pressure, contradiction, lattice alignment, FRW RAS, and FRW FCI strengthen or weaken the temporal read.
4 · Artifact distillationThe canonical export records Chronodynamic Intelligence and the Human Read Layer distills it into posture, likely continuation, anomaly pressure, and intervention cue.
